description: D365FO Segregation of Duties rules — sample ruleset based on ISACA/COSO frameworks

rules.name: Vendor Maintenance vs Payment Approval
rules.description: A user who can create/modify vendors should not also approve payments to those vendors

rules.name: Purchase Order Creation vs Approval
rules.description: A user who creates purchase orders should not also approve them

rules.name: Journal Entry vs Journal Approval
rules.description: A user who creates journal entries should not also approve or post them

rules.name: Customer Maintenance vs Payment Application
rules.description: A user who can modify customer records should not also apply incoming payments

rules.name: Vendor Invoice Processing vs Payment Processing
rules.description: A user who processes vendor invoices should not also process vendor payments
